text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm out and about with Mejiro

McQueen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
My, look at that, Trainer. What an
adorable little
plushie.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I follow Мэдзиро МакКуин's gaze and see

Umamusume plushies on display as
prizes for a
claw machine.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин seems to have really
taken a
shine to them. She stares
intently.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
N-no, of course not. I was merely a bit
intrigued
by it.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Besides, this game looks difficult. I
wouldn't be
able to win.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: Then I'll win it for you.

text_block_list.text: Теперь я ни за что не могу подвести!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
